summary: DS3231 I²C real-time clock with integrated TCXO and crystal (ds3231): 8 pins, interfaces i2c; source class A1.

module.title: DS3231 I²C real-time clock with integrated TCXO and crystal

pins.name: 32KHZ
pins.note: 32 kHz output, open drain, needs a pull-up; may be left open (p. 9)

pins.name: INT/SQW
pins.note: open drain, pull-up to ≤ 5.5 V; may be left unconnected (p. 9)

pins.name: RST

up.evidence: 50kΩ nominal value pullup resistor to VCC.

pins.note: power-fail reset / push-button input; no external pull-up (p. 9)

pins.name: VBAT
pins.note: backup cell 2.3–5.5 V; connect to ground if not used (p. 9); default tie GND

addresses.evidence: which is 1101000, followed by the direction bit (R/ W),

abs_max.evidence: Voltage Range on Any Pin Relative to Ground ....-0.3V to +6.0V

vih.evidence: Logic 1 Input SDA, SCL VIH 0.7 x VCC VCC + 0.3 V

vil.evidence: Logic 0 Input SDA, SCL VIL -0.3 0.3 x VCC V

v_in_max.evidence: Voltage Range on Any Pin Relative to Ground ....-0.3V to +6.0V
v_in_max.conditions: absolute maximum rating, any pin; in operation SDA/SCL pull-ups up to 5.5 V regardless of VCC (p. 9)

max.evidence: Active Supply Current ICCA (Notes 4, 5) VCC = 3.63V 200 µAVCC = 5.5V 300
max.conditions: active, SCL 400 kHz; worst case at VCC 5.5 V (200 µA at 3.63 V)

peak.evidence: Temperature Conversion Current ICCSCONV I2C bus inactive, 32kHz output on, SQW output off VCC = 3.63V 575 µAVCC = 5.5V 650
peak.conditions: temperature conversion; worst case at VCC 5.5 V (575 µA at 3.63 V)

sleep.conditions: standby, I²C inactive; worst case at VCC 5.5 V (110 µA at 3.63 V)

requires.evidence: This pin should be decoupled using a 0.1µF to 1.0µF capacitor.
This open-drain pin requires an external pullup resistor. The pullup voltage can be up to 5.5V, regardless of the voltage on VCC.
requires.note: value from the I²C pull-up calculator

notes.text: Pins 5–12 (N.C.) of the SO16 package must be grounded.
notes.evidence: 5–12 N.C. No Connection. Must be connected to ground.

notes.text: Backup supply VBAT 2.3–5.5 V; timekeeping battery current max 3.0 µA at VBAT 3.63 V.
At VCC 5 V the SDA/SCL input high threshold is 0.7 × VCC = 3.5 V, above a 3.3 V bus: power the DS3231 from 3.3 V (rule mod.rtc.ds3231_vih).
notes.evidence: Logic 1 Input SDA, SCL VIH 0.7 x VCC VCC + 0.3 V

notes.text: DS3231 VBAT input: designed for a primary lithium cell.
notes.evidence: UL recognized to ensure against reverse charging when used with a primary lithium battery.
